author: K. D. Hardy
title: Grade 4 leads Caledonia Elementary in mathematics MCA participation for 2024-25
text:
At Caledonia Elementary School, students in grade 4 demonstrated the highest mathematics MCA participation rate for 2024-25, the Minnesota Department of Education reports.
Out of 139 students who completed the mathematics portion of the test, 51 were fourth-graders at Caledonia Elementary.
Test results showed 75% of Caledonia’s fourth-grade students met mathematics proficiency standards.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are statewide assessments designed to measure student achievement of Minnesota’s academic standards and fulfill legislative requirements. The tests cover math, reading, and science, depending on grade level. While most students participate in the MCA, some who receive special education services and meet eligibility criteria may take the Alt MCA.
Minnesota’s statewide proficiency rates on the MCA have decreased from pre-pandemic levels , Minnesota’s Report Card shows. Mathematics proficiency declined by more than 7% compared with 2019, and reading proficiency fell by roughly 5%.
